verses.text: When Jethro, the high priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt;

title: JST, Exodus 18:1. Compare Exodus 18:1 Jethro is a high priest.
